2.6 Planned Activities after the Fellowship Period The planned activities after the 12 months of the fellowship at IVI are mainly the review and the development of two manuscripts for publication with my supervisor (Dr. Jean-Louis Excler) and the Policy and Economic Research Department of IVI.  2.7 Appraisal from the Fellow This CRD fellowship programme offered me in a good learning environment for clinical research and also for personal development with a multicultural profile of IVI. It also gave me the opportunity to meet people who are advanced clinical research scientists. As a beginner, I tried to benefit of the maximum of inspiring information from them.  The CRD fellowship programme enabled me to expand more my vision, to get clear professional career goals and to be more confident for the development of trial protocols and the conduct of clinical trial according to the international standard. I am confident in my abilities to make significant contribution and to impact positively the conduct of clinical research activities.  IVI with its knowledge, know-how and skills in clinical research through its core departments of “Development and Delivery Unit” (Clinical Trial and Regulatory, Biostatistics and Data Management, Epidemiology, Policy and Health Economics) provided me an appropriate and a supportive learning environment.  2.8 Comments, if any, from the Supervisor in the Host Institution We are delighted to have had Mohamadou Siribie among us as full member of the Clinical Development team and greatly appreciate his contribution to the various projects he is involved in. Mohamadou Siribie has been very productive during his stay at IVI. We particularly appreciate his passion for public health and his constructive comments during our multiple interactions. We sincerely hope we can maintain and develop a long-term collaboration with Mohamadou Siribie in Burkina-Faso.  2.9 Acknowledgements I am thankful to: -­‐ WHO-TDR and EDCTP for offering this great opportunity to young scientists from Low- and Middle-Income Countries for their career development and the capacity building of their home institution. -­‐ IVI for offering me the opportunity to be hosted in the institution. -­‐ My host supervisors, Dr. Laura Digilio and Dr. Jean-Louis Excler, for their warm welcome and their availabilities. I am learning a lot from their great experience.
